expected_geometry.geometry_measurement: Actual evaluated depsgraph meshes, including rounded joinery/bevel modifiers, matching export_apply=True; not raw source face counts.

measured_duplicate_face_repair.method: Actual Mesh.validate duplicateface repair BEFORE export expectation; glTF exporter invokes this same validation. No coordinate/UV approximation and no relaxed triangle gate. Native unchanged unless explicitly saved by a separate source-repair stage.

portable_scan_cap_triangulation.method: ExplicitTriangulate modifier for nontriangle source cap faces, UV/materials/custom normals retained; native source untouched. Strict reimport triangle gate unchanged.

scope: All saved-source town component geometry; source SHA is provenance, not visual acceptance; omit redundant auxiliary500m plane and crop only legacy1000m horizon to112x100m snow context; original64x52m plaza and all buildings/furniture unchanged. Static editable people: licensed photographic scan meshes are not rigged; original generic human rigs remain separate alternatives where documented
portability_limitations: Blender area lights and photographic world are not faithfully represented by core glTF; punctual lights only where supported.
Procedural shader details fall back to portable Principled/PBR values where unsupported; native is authoritative for lighting/glass/colour management.
Photographic scan maps resampled to2048px, other maps512px for portable memory budget; original packed maps remain in full-resolution natives.
